Hi Samantha / Marcus,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through HealthLynx's onboarding priorities. As promised, here's a concise follow-up to clarify the security evaluation path and what we need to make the process smooth.

Quick recap from the call:
- HealthLynx will evaluate Redwood for primary inference in your clinical triage pipeline (POC -> Prod).
- Security asks to confirm: SOC 2 status, data residency (EU vs US), HIPAA applicability for PHI flows, and whether you prefer a CAIQ/SIG prefill or a custom questionnaire.

Items we can action quickly:
1) Decision on form type (CAIQ, full SIG, or your custom XLS). If you want us to prefill CAIQ/SIG-lite we can do that in 2 business days; full SIG-prefill (complete mapping + evidence links) is ~4 business days.
2) If HIPAA applies, confirm whether HealthLynx requires a BAA before evidence exchange.
3) Preferred timeline for a short follow-up (15–20 min) to confirm the form choice and owners.

Attachments: please see the vendor questionnaire you shared on the call (I've attached the file you uploaded to the portal).

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm preferred form and BAA requirement by EOD Wed (Aug 12).
- If CAIQ or SIG-lite selected, we'll deliver a prefilled document and a short evidence map. If custom chosen, we will put together a scope and estimate.

Thanks — looping in Rishi (security) and Priyom (sales ops) for any immediate clarifications.

Best,

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the summary — that matches our notes. A few clarifying points from our side before we pick the form:

1) SOC 2: Are you able to share the latest SOC 2 Type II report and auditor contact? We need the report for our risk committee, ideally redacted.
2) GDPR / residency: We're primarily US-based with some EU patients; we'd like to confirm whether Redwood can commit to EU data processing controls or if routing to US-only infra is required.
3) HIPAA: Yes — PHI will be present in the POC. We generally request a signed BAA before substantial evidence exchange.
4) Form preference: We attached our internal vendor questionnaire (the XLS you have). If you can prefill CAIQ/ SIG-lite that would speed things up. If full SIG-prefill is a longer task, we may accept SIG-lite + evidence bundle first.

Can Rishi confirm what artifacts you can reasonably share up-front (SOC report, encryption architecture diagram, incident response summary)? Also, what's the earliest you can get a prefilled CAIQ back to us?

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Security & Privacy Program Manager
HealthLynx

Thanks Samantha — good questions. Quick answers and a proposed plan:

SOC 2: We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (2025) and the auditor contact under an NDA/after a BAA if required for HIPAA. Attached is the redacted report stub we'll provide once you confirm BAA preference.

GDPR / residency: Redwood supports per-customer routing policies. For HealthLynx we can either:
- Route EU data to our EU region (data stays in-region) OR
- Keep everything in US region for the POC if you prefer (reduce cross-border complexity).
Please confirm preference.

Prefill timeline/options:
- CAIQ / SIG-lite prefill + evidence map: 2 business days from confirmation (we'll include links to hosted artifacts).
- Full SIG prefill (complete question-by-question with evidence attachments): 4 business days; requires a short internal scoping call to map custom asks in your XLS.

BAA: If HealthLynx requires a BAA before records exchange, please send the preferred BAA or we can circulate Redwood's standard BAA for review.

I've attached a short "prefill scope" PDF that outlines what we include in a CAIQ vs full SIG prefill and where we map evidence. If that looks good we can proceed on whichever timeline you pick.

Proposed calendar: 15-min alignment on Thu Aug 13 at 11:00 AM PT. If that works I'll send an invite.

Best,
Ava
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_prefill_scope.pdf (PDF; 18KB)
